title: Quadratic and $p$-th variation of random signed Takagi--Landsberg bridges
abstract: arXiv:2609.21688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study random signed Takagi--Landsberg bridges with independent Rademacher Faber--Schauder coefficients. At index $H=1/2$, we prove that every fixed deterministic refining sequence of partitions with vanishing mesh yields quadratic variation $t$, almost surely and uniformly in $t\in[0,1]$. For partitions that need not be refining, the mesh condition $o(1/\log n)$ is sufficient, and its order is sharp. Our proofs use an operator representation of the quadratic sums and moment bounds for Rademacher chaos. We also show that asymmetric signs can destroy this invariance. At every index $H\ne1/2$, we construct a deterministic refining sequence along which the critical $p$-power sums, with $p=1/H$, have two distinct finite accumulation points almost surely. At $H=1/4$, uniform thirds grids provide an explicit alternative to the dyadic limit. Thus $H=1/2$ is the unique index in the symmetric family at which critical variation is invariant al

translated_title: 随机符号Takagi--Landsberg桥的二次变差与p次变差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.21688v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：我们研究了具有独立Rademacher Faber--Schauder系数的随机符号Takagi--Landsberg桥。在指标H=1/2处，我们证明：对于任意固定的、网格趋于零的确定性加细剖分序列，其二次变差几乎必然且关于t∈[0,1]一致地等于t。对于不一定是加细的剖分序列，网格条件o(1/log n)即已足够，且其阶数是精确最优的。我们的证明使用了二次和的算子表示以及Rademacher混沌的矩估计。我们还证明非对称符号可以破坏这种不变性。在所有指标H≠1/2处，我们构造了一个确定性加细序列，沿该序列临界p次幂和（其中p=1/H）几乎必然具有两个不同的有限聚点。在H=1/4处，均匀三分网格为二进极限提供了一个显式的替代方案。因此，H=1/2是该对称族中临界变差具有不变性的唯一指标。
tldr: 该论文证明了随机符号Takagi--Landsberg桥在H=1/2时二次变差对任意加细剖分序列几乎必然且一致地等于t，而在H≠1/2时临界p次变差可呈现两个不同的聚点，从而确立了H=1/2是该对称族中临界变差不变性成立的唯一指标。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that for random signed Takagi--Landsberg bridges, the quadratic variation equals t almost surely and uniformly at index H=1/2 for any refining partition sequence, while for H≠1/2 the critical p-th power sums exhibit two distinct accumulation points, establishing H=1/2 as the unique index in the symmetric family where critical variation is invariant.
